definitions.explanation: A bond issued by a national government to finance public spending. A key instrument in government finance.

examples.japanese: {国債|こくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{国債|こくさい}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{増|ふ}え→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Japan's outstanding government debt keeps growing.

examples.japanese: {低金利|ていきんり}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{国債|こくさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利回|りまわ}り→利回り：18661_rimawari⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{低|ひく}く→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In an era of low interest rates, government bond yields also fall.

notes:
USAGE:
A key financial and economic term frequently seen in news. {国債|こくさい} is the bond itself, not the aggregate national debt; the total is {国債|こくさい}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧ or ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧. Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧ (international), which is far more common in daily life.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {国債|こくさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発行|はっこう}する→発行する：19236_hakkousuru⟧: to issue government bonds
- {国債|こくさい}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: outstanding government debt
- {国債|こくさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{利回|りまわ}り→利回り：18661_rimawari⟧: government bond yield
- {国債|こくさい}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: government bond market
- ⟦{赤字|あかじ}→赤字：04712_akaji⟧{国債|こくさい}: deficit-financing bonds

cross_references.description: Homophone. {国際|こくさい} means international.
